overview_description.description: Command AI is a user assistance platform that helps product, growth, and CX teams unleash their users with AI chat and in-product nudges. The platform provides user assistance without annoyance, aimed at helping product, marketing, and customer teams engage their users effectively. Command AI achieves business outcomes by prioritizing the experience of end users.

about_short_description.short_description: Command AI is a firm that offers simple, AI-powered user assistance to make applications easier to use.

product.name: AI-Guided Nudges
product.description: A tool for product and growth teams that delivers personalized prompts to guide users within applications.

product.name: AI Support Agent (Copilot)
product.description: An embedded AI-powered support agent that assists users by answering questions and providing guided walkthroughs within applications.

product.name: Product Tours
product.description: Interactive guided tours within applications that help users learn features and improve onboarding conversion.

product.name: Surveys and In-App Feedback
product.description: Tools to collect user feedback and conduct surveys within applications to inform product decisions and improve user experience.

product.name: Checklists
product.description: Self-guided onboarding checklists that help users complete key tasks and track their progress within an application.

product.name: Spotlight
product.description: A search and navigation tool that helps users find content and features within an application quickly and efficiently.
